import csv, hashlib, importlib.util, json, shutil
from pathlib import Path
sim=Path.cwd()
root=(sim/'test-results/pr33824_expanded_all13_predictors_20260928_1933').resolve()
previous=(sim/'test-results/pr33824_comprehensive_all13_predictors_20260918_1605').resolve()
out=root/'verification/historical_request_identity_all13_20260929_0303'
assert not out.exists()
helper=sim/'tools/append_pr33824_expanded_report.py'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('historical_identity_report',helper)
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(module)
current=module.key_values(root/'run_metadata.txt')
old=module.key_values(previous/'run_metadata.txt')
models=current['models'].split(',')
assert len(models)==13 and len(set(models))==13
assert models==old['models'].split(',')
assert (previous/'FINAL_REPORT_COMPLETE').read_text().strip()=='complete'
assert old['protocol']=='same_workload_independent_train_holdout'
assert not set(old['training_seeds'].split(',')) & set(old['heldout_seeds'].split(','))
assert int(old['training_requests_total'])==int(old['heldout_requests_total'])==320
paths={previous/'run_metadata.txt', previous/'FINAL_REPORT_COMPLETE'}
closed_cases=0
for model in models:
    paths.add(previous/'models'/model/'REAL_ML_COMPLETE')
    assert (previous/'models'/model/'REAL_ML_COMPLETE').read_text().strip()=='complete'
    for role,repeat_key,case_key,seed_key in [('calibration','training_real_repeats','training_case','training_seeds'),('holdout','heldout_real_repeats','heldout_case','heldout_seeds')]:
        groups=sorted((previous/'models'/model/role/'real').glob('repeat-*'))
        assert len(groups)==int(old[repeat_key])==5
        assert {g.name for g in groups}=={f'repeat-{i}' for i in range(1,6)}
        assert len(set(old[seed_key].split(',')))==5
        for group in groups:
            marker=group/'BASELINE_COLLECTION_COMPLETE'
            assert marker.read_text().strip()=='complete'; paths.add(marker)
            group_metadata=group/'run_metadata.txt'
            actual=module.key_values(group_metadata)
            assert actual['seed']==old[seed_key].split(',')[int(group.name.split('-')[-1])-1]
            paths.add(group_metadata)
            cases=sorted((group/'cases').glob('*/TP0.raw_request.jsonl'))
            assert {p.parent.name for p in cases}==set(old[case_key].split(','))
            for raw in cases:
                status=raw.parent/'status.txt'
                manifest=raw.parent/'TP0.manifest.json'
                trace=raw.parent/'autobench_trace.jsonl'
                assert status.read_text().strip()=='ok'
                payload=json.loads(manifest.read_text())
                raw_count=sum(bool(line.strip()) for line in raw.read_text().splitlines())
                assert raw_count==payload['request_count']==int(old['requests_per_trace'])==64
                paths.update((raw,status,manifest,trace)); closed_cases+=1
assert closed_cases==130
before={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(paths)}
original_helper_sha=hashlib.sha256(helper.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
out.mkdir(parents=True)
shutil.copy2(helper,out/'executed_report_helper.py')
lines=module.request_identity_details(previous,models,out)
rows=module.read_csv(out/'train_test_request_identity.csv')
assert len(rows)==13
assert all(int(row['training_requests'])==int(row['heldout_requests'])==320 for row in rows)
assert all(int(row['real_to_replay_ids_verified'])==640 for row in rows)
assert all(hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==value for path,value in before.items())
assert hashlib.sha256(helper.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==original_helper_sha
module.write_csv(out/'source_sha256.csv',[{'path':p,'sha256':h} for p,h in before.items()])
(out/'report_sections.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines),encoding='utf-8')
manifest={'previous_root':str(previous),'models':models,'closed_cases':closed_cases,'verified_payload_requests':sum(int(r['real_to_replay_ids_verified']) for r in rows),'input_files_verified_unchanged':len(before),'summary_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'train_test_request_identity.csv').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'executed_helper_source_sha256':original_helper_sha,'executed_helper_function':'request_identity_details','protocol':old['protocol'],'training_seeds':old['training_seeds'].split(','),'heldout_seeds':old['heldout_seeds'].split(','),'no_fit_prediction_gpu_or_historical_mutation':True,'limitation':'Request/trace identity audit, not proof of accuracy, timing-label fit membership or cause of an error change.'}
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(manifest,ensure_ascii=False))
print(json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False))
